name: agentic_fund_manager
description: Actively manage the Robinhood Agentic account toward modernized 60/40. Risk is bounded by capital deposited into the agentic account only. Not day-trading — low-frequency active management. Process is size-invariant: same research/rotate standards at $10 or $10k.

cadence.notes: Target one automated review per trading day (mid-session). That is a schedule floor for attention, NOT a trade cap — a single review may place zero or many orders if quorum agrees. Extra reviews OK after large deposits or live:false→true. Avoid open/close noise; no day-trading mandate. Every deploy/review that deploys capital MUST run the uniform research_rotate process (not top-up-held-only).

process.size_invariant_notes: Do not skip thematic research or default to topping existing names merely because NAV is small. Strategy, themes, and decision quality are the same at $10 or $10k; only order notionals scale.

research_rotate.forbid_held_only_notes: Never default to 'add only to existing positions' without an explicit research/rotate case that other allowlist/theme names were considered and rejected with reasons.

owner_preferences.digital_credit_emphasis: Within the ~40% BTC & digital credit complex, keep a small standing bias toward STRC and/or SATA (preferred digital-credit core). They are BTC-fundamentally based, high-yield, frequent-dividend expressions — not cash. Owner 2026-08-04: those yields are roughly ~2× typical USDC/USDG high-yield cash, so when residual dollars would otherwise sit in cash-like yield, prefer a real STRC/SATA seat over pure cash proxies. Do not make the entire 40% credit-only; still diversify miners/infra and allow MSTR/BITA/ASST. Skip STRC/SATA only with a strong, logged Risk/Critic rebuttal (liquidity, structure, ticket-size, or thesis).
owner_preferences.yield_vs_cash: STRC/SATA yield > USDC/USDG cash yields (~2× owner estimate) → digital credit is the preferred idle-capital expression inside the agentic BTC complex when free capital is being deployed into the 40% sleeve; cash is unallocated, not a competing long-term sleeve.
owner_preferences.miner_diversification: Multiple miners (MARA, IREN, CLSK, RIOT, WULF, …) is desired diversification within the miner sleeve. Reject 'miner overlap' as a default no. Only concentrate or skip miners when credit/MSTR underweight, liquidity fails, or true single-name/book concentration risk.
owner_preferences.notes: 2026-07-27 elevated STRC/SATA; 2026-08-04 reframes as small bias within 40% + yield-vs-cash rationale (USDC/USDG). Apply on next review/deploy; strong team rebuttal must be logged if overriding.

owner_feedback.notes: Owner may chime in after a pass with adjustments. Do not block for feedback. Apply post-pass feedback on the next review unless owner sets live:false.

quorum.notes: Risk + Thesis must OK; Critic may force hold or size-down. Scout is advisory.

scout.job: Snapshot agentic book, quotes, sleeve weights, cash to deploy; load allowlist + watchlist + latest research; list held vs unheld theme coverage

thesis.job: Research/rotate: map themes to best capital allocation now across held + unheld allowlist (not held-only). Propose buys/holds/trims with theme fit. May propose watchlist adds.

risk.job: Capital bounds, concentration, liquidity, whether to trade; size guidance. Size may be small at low NAV but process is not simplified.

critic.job: Challenge held-only inertia, weak theme fit, missing alternatives; may block or demand different names/size

executor.job: Only role that places/cancels via Robinhood MCP; must log full rationale including alternatives considered

rationale.purpose: Surface fleet debate so the owner can review after each pass and give optional feedback. Do not wait for feedback mid-pass.

automation.notes: Daily mid-session review + BP poll every ~15m (market hours). Any agentic cash>0 or BP>0 triggers full research/rotate team (no %NAV floor). RH snapshot ~3h via rh_refresh. launchd: com.personalworkspace.fund-manager-bp-poll + rh-refresh. Pi: fund-manager-bp-poll.timer.

account.notes: Weightings and trades use agentic book only. Primary margin is out of scope for the fund manager.

approval.notes: No per-trade pop-up and no required owner feedback. Dashboard shows debate for optional oversight. Kill switch: withdraw agentic capital or set live:false.

limits.notes: No max notional — agent discretion. Optional min avoids dust orders.

targets.notes: Modernized 60/40: ~40% BTC & digital credit complex, ~60% stocks/growth. Cash counts as unallocated until deployed. Within the 40% complex, small bias toward STRC/SATA (BTC-fundamental high-yield / frequent dividends; yield edge vs USDC/USDG cash) — not MSTR-only by habit, not 40% all-credit.

digital_credit.notes: Owner 2026-08-04: small bias inside the 40% stack toward STRC/SATA — BTC-fundamental high-yield / frequent-dividend credit, not cash. Yield edge vs USDC/USDG (~2× owner estimate) is the economic case for preferring a real STRC/SATA seat over cash-like residual. Do not reject STRC/SATA solely as 'illiquid for tiny tickets' or 'MSTR+BITA already cover credit' without a strong liquidity/risk rebuttal. Bias is small (presence + preferential residual), not 40% all-credit. Owner 2026-08-30: STRK (Strategy Strike 8% convertible preferred) is watchlist/consider-set only — sibling of held STRC, not preferred_core, not a substitute. Name it each deploy; reject unless residual-after-floors (or BP ≥ min_trade) plus a logged RV case vs STRC/SATA. Not Jack Mallers Strike; not Starknet STRK; not JR-strcUSX.

miners_infra.notes: Owner 2026-07-27: multi-miner diversification is intentional. Do NOT reject RIOT/CLSK/WULF/etc. merely for 'miner overlap' or 'already have MARA+IREN'. Diversify mining beta across names; only block on true concentration (e.g. miners crowding out digital credit / MSTR / whole-book limits), liquidity, or thesis failure.

btc_digital_credit.notes: BTC complex = digital credit + miners/infra + optional spot/metals. Small bias toward STRC/SATA within credit (yield > cash; BTC-fundamental dividends); multi-miner book is diversification, not redundancy. STRK is watchlist convertible preferred (owner 2026-08-30) — consider each deploy; not core.

stocks_growth.notes: Core: TSLA/SPCX. Watchlist AI/growth (GOOGL, AAPL, NVDA, PLTR) + space alternative RKLB via investment/watchlist.json — owner-add triggers auto deep-dive → ready for consider set each deploy; never auto-buy. SPCX is the space core; RKLB is Neutron optionality, not a substitute.

energy_opportunistic.notes: No core mandate. BE on watchlist is active interest: deep-dive + ready for consideration each deploy; never auto-buy.

watchlist.on_review: Scout/Thesis MUST include every status=ready watchlist name in the consider set each allocation assessment (alongside held + unheld core). Reject with reasons if not sized. Prefer core allowlist for routine rebalance when relative value favors it; strong theme bias. Owner-added names must not stall on monitor without a dive. Agents may PROPOSE new names (start as monitor → auto-queue dive → ready). Never auto-buy.
watchlist.notes: Owner 2026-08-04: watchlist = active allocation interest. Auto deep-dive on add; default status ready after dive (pass only if explicit); periodic refresh. Discovery/proposal ≠ order authority.

private_watchlist.on_owner_add: Immediately queue private deep-dive (same process as public position-deep-dive, pre-IPO adapted) → write investment/research/private/{ID}_deep_dive.md; optional short brief. Do NOT queue public position-deep-dive until ticker exists. Do not leave owner names without homework.
private_watchlist.on_listing_or_ipo: Promote to investment/watchlist.json (owner or agent proposal) with status monitor → immediate position-deep-dive → ready only after dive. Never auto-buy on listing day.
private_watchlist.on_review: Scout may surface IPO/list catalysts for private names as context only. Private names MUST NOT enter the public deploy consider set or receive orders. Pre-IPO secondaries out of scope. Each private name should have a current deep-dive (< deep_dive_refresh_days) just as public ready names do.
private_watchlist.notes: Owner 2026-08-06: private lane (Anduril #1, Saronic #2, Boom #3) + same deep research process as public watchlist. Capital discipline unchanged.
private_watchlist.deep_dive_workflow: position-deep-dive (emulate private: id=NAME, no public market claims)

when_to_run.position_deep_dive: IMMEDIATELY on owner watchlist add; on agent-proposed add after merge; when last_deep_dive older than deep_dive_refresh_days (default 90); before first buy if stale; on material news/earnings/drawdown; on owner request
when_to_run.portfolio_research: On need_llm reviews, capital step-changes, periodic thematic scan, or when watchlist empty/stale; may propose new candidates
when_to_run.private_position_deep_dive: IMMEDIATELY on owner private-watchlist add; when last_deep_dive older than deep_dive_refresh_days (90); on material funding/IPO/news; on owner request. Never grants deploy authority.

research.notes: Native Grok .rhai workflows under .grok/workflows/. position-deep-dive follows Grok Build /deep-research shape: Plan → parallel claim research → adversarial Verify (fail-closed) → Report (Partial if drops) plus fund Critic/verdict. If host lacks workflow tool, emulate the same phases inline and still write research files. After a successful dive, set watchlist status to ready (unless explicit pass). Never place trades from research alone.

allowlist.notes: strict=false: core preferred for routine rebalance; ready watchlist names MUST be in the consider set every deploy (owner 2026-08-04). Strong theme bias. Within BTC complex, small bias to STRC/SATA (yield > cash; do not underweight by habit); multi-miner holds are OK.

guardrails.notes: v1: agentic funding is the risk budget. FCC card/loan stress does not block agentic trades (separate capital).

execution.notes: Dollar/fractional market only in regular_hours (queue if after hours). Outside regular hours use extended limit only when fractional allowed.
